title: Textual Entailment is not a Better Bias Metric than Token Probability
findings: The paper includes religious stereotypes (e.g., 'sinful') as one of eighteen categories in its WinoQueer benchmark for anti-LGBTQ+ bias, but does not report specific findings for the religious category itself. The main findings concern the instability and low correlation of Natural Language Inference (NLI) based bias metrics compared to token probability-based metrics across all stereotype categories.
